scope: Source provenance and exact installed-runtime binary-delta equivalence; no claim of a complete reproducible Wine build.

correction.source_change: Select current info.Protect and derive noexec=(info.Protect & ~0xff) | ((info.Protect & 0xf0) >> 4); remove the zero-only PAGE_NOACCESS fallback.
correction.behavior_scope: Current non-executable pages bypass the helper. Current executable pages map their base to NOACCESS/READONLY/READWRITE/WRITECOPY and preserve high-byte modifiers. This fixes modifier-only requests from V1 and preserves read/write class for executable pages.
correction.helper_hash_extent: Starts with static void toggle_executable_pages_for_rosetta( and ends with the closing brace plus one newline; complete virtual.c hash is separate.

exact_binary.rationale: The existing query buffer is rbp-0xf0. Load displacement 0x20 -> 0x34 selects Protect at structure +0x24 instead of AllocationProtect +0x10. SHR CL,4 preserves ECX bits 8–31 and exactly maps (Protect & ~0xff) | ((Protect & 0xf0) >>4). Nine NOPs preserve the twelve-byte extent, all following addresses, branches, and unwind metadata. No flags from this calculation are consumed before NtProtect resets them.
exact_binary.unsigned_terminology: Persisted pre-sign bytes retain the stale original embedded signature; not stripped signature.

limitations: This is an exact binary delta and source correction, not a full Wine source rebuild.
No runtime execution, installation, activation, or gameplay validation occurred.
The field-selection defect is concrete; retrospective crash causality and gameplay effect remain unverified.
NtProtect statuses, independent remote protection calls, range/lifetime races and executable-only NOACCESS behavior are not changed by this correction.
In force_exec_prot mode the helper can preserve logical reads but Wine may re-add host execute permission; V2 does not establish equivalent Rosetta invalidation in that broader runtime mode.
